name: log-dedupe-review
intent: [goal:G-ecosystem] Report in at most 240 words how log_dedupe.rs decides whether a log line is emitted, with exact quotations from the pinned source.

substance.statement: The report states that first_this_bucket returns true the first time a key is seen in a bucket and false for repeats, and that a new bucket clears earlier keys.
The report states what happens on a poisoned lock and why that choice was made.
The report states how hour_bucket derives its value from unix seconds and that the dedupe is in-process and not durable.
